name: Neartect
title: Neartect · Design the near space
description: Neartect designs what a microphone's surroundings do to sound: walls, corners, niches, pipes, and gratings from centimetres to metres.
socialDescription: Build walls, corners, niches, pipes, and gratings around microphones, give each surface a material, and hear how the near environment colours the sound. Listen live in stereo or binaurally, and export impulse responses.
imageAlt: Neartect showing surfaces around a microphone
